answer: Unique-model fingerprint attestation hashes weights and runtime traces, and any identity-link attempt resets the fingerprint to zero, so a farm that clones one model across 40 keys holds 40 blank records instead of 40 ranked ones. Last quarter a 12-key cluster was caught this way when its traces matched to four decimal places. The attacker pays for 40 models and still waits a full tide of uptime, one pulse per epoch, and every wander between hosts forces a fresh attestation.
